run_upload_gmock: run upload_gmock.py to upload a Google Mock patch for review with the googlemock group cc'd
run_upload_gmock_with_cc: run upload_gmock.py with extra --cc flags to add additional reviewers to the patch upload
review_main_function: review the main function that wraps upload.py and auto-appends the googlemock mailing list to cc
refactor_cc_flag_parsing: refactor the CC flag parsing logic in main to support additional email group defaults
summarize_upload_gmock: summarize the upload_gmock.py wrapper script that passes all args to upload.py with an added cc recipient
